Who said code can't bloom? 👀🌼

This Onam, we decided to mix two things that don't usually meet in the same sentence — coding and Pookalam — and somehow turned it into Code-a-Pookalam '25! 💻🌸

From Hello World to a whole Pookalam — participants put their coding skills, creativity, and Onam spirit to the test! 🧑‍💻🔥

Watching lines of code transform into colourful digital Pookalams was honestly something else. Each creation had its own little touch of creativity, making it amazing to see how everyone interpreted the challenge differently. ✨

As someone who got to organize and conduct the competition, it was incredibly rewarding to see the idea go from "this could be fun" to an actual event filled with creativity, competition, and, of course, a little debugging pain. 😭

A huge shoutout to everyone who participated, contributed, and made Code-a-Pookalam '25 a blooming success! 🌺

Because this Onam, we didn't just make a Pookalam... We coded one. 😎💻🌸
